item.title: [ Mod ] Solum Aesthetics
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
This addon covers both L4D1 and L4D2 campaigns. This uses the original Team Silent Aesthetics as a base and covers L4D2 Campaigns. I tried to aim for a 'realistic' look with mostly clear and cloudy skies, sprinkled in some fog that looks the best on Swamp Fever, there are no stars in the sky, figured it'd feel lonelier that way. None of the original skyboxes/color corrections were touched and therefore every visual aspect from the original addon is the same in this one. All of the skyboxes were sampled from gamebanana, color corrections made by me and sampled from various sources (Silent Hill franchise, Backrooms wiki, r/liminalspace images). The fog script was adjusted and edited to enable it on L4D2 Campaigns. (Special thanks to yorver for giving me permission to do so.) All graffiti has been removed to fit SOLUM. You're gonna have to see The Passing for yourself. This addon is not finished, I am planning to make my own custom materials. Credits: Darker L4D2 World Textures by Farty Freak Team Silent Aesthetics by yoru and Retro Customizable Fog Script by ChimiChamo

item.title: [ Mod ] [FN: Rearousal] Frenni Fazclaire (Coach)
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
"Welcome to Fazclaire's! Party, dance, or kick back with our next-level cyborg idols late into the night. Our mind-blowing personalities will leave you with an unforgettable experience! Fazclaire ENT is not liable for a missing person or death. Adults only. Please drink and party responsibly." I’d like to clarify that I did not create the mod and the model port myself. The model port and the VGUI icons (Lobby, Panel, and Incap) were created by another person who preferred to remain anonymous. This was a commissioned mod, which he kindly helped with the port of the model and the creation of the icons for said commission, also he gave me permission to upload the mod to the Steam Workshop so it can be shared with everyone. I want to give him my sincere thanks for his work. Also, in case you wonder what's up with the name of FN: Rearousal (Fazclaire's Nightclub: The Rearousal), It's the official name that CryptiaCurves gave for the redesigned version of her Fazclaire's Nightclub models. Features: - World Model - FP Arms - Facial Flexes - Jiggle Bones - Bile Texture - Custom HUD - Custom Attachments - Rochelle's animations Original model by: CryptiaCurves You can buy the models at cryptiacurves.itch.io If you find problems in the mod, feel free to tell me about them in the comments.

item.title: [ Mod ] KM Style Michiru Kagemori (Zoey) with L4D Styled Icons
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 4
I hadn't originally planned to edit the icons for Zoey's version of 7EMP3ST's KM style Michiru as well, but after seeing how much people liked the edited version of Rochelle on the Steam Workshop, I see why not do the same with Zoey's version along with the fixed textures of the Jacket. The Incap icon is the same but the Lobby and Panel icons are totally remade. This is a personal custom-edit mod of 7EMP3ST's KM style Michiru Kagemori (Zoey) mod. It alters the VGUI/HUD icons (the Lobby, Panel, and Incap icons) to a cleaner L4D-styled look. I also slightly edited the jacket textures, removing the gray parts from the original model since they looked out of place. I made this edit because while the original portraits that come with the original model of the mod are not bad by any stretch, they don't match the portraits that come with the majority of skin mods from other modders. Original Mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3084780837 ___________________________________________________ Credits: Kabalmystic - Body base model Niyel98 - Original model assets JosugomezOfficialNEW - Original Kabalmystic Style model edit 7EMP3ST - Original mod creator Michiru Kagemori is from "BNA: Brand New Animal"
